title: Cebu: Easterlies bring isolated rains, but heat index at ‘extreme caution’

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu will continue to experience generally fair weather, although isolated rain showers and thunderstorms may occur amid warm and humid conditions on Thursday, November 26, according to the state weather bureau. The Visayas Pagasa Regional Services Division (PRSD) said partly cloudy to cloudy skies would be expected across the province as easterlies, or warm winds from the east, would influence local weather conditions. Similar conditions are forecast in most parts of the Visayas and Occidental Mindoro, with light to moderate winds and slight to moderate seas throughout the day.
